record.question: Which of the following line of latitude is also known as the great circle?
record.explanation: Answer C: Equator. The Equator is a great circle dividing Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Reference: https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/greatcircle.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC Law & Judicial Paper-I, February 2026 examination; current officeholder/current affairs claims interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
